messages:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Leaving a short live thread for any follow-ups on mission, positioning, competitors. Keep Qs snappy and we'll answer.
Jules (PM): One-liner we can use for press: what differentiator should we lead with?
Aisha (CEO): Lead with the operational promise: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical for production apps." Then pick one supporting proof point.
Priya (Growth): For marketing, should we call out hosted vs dedicated in the same headline or separate flows?
Dana (Product): Separate flows. Headline for devs = hosted simplicity. Enterprise page = Dedicated + Private + SLAs.
Sam (Eng): Competitors claim lower per-token rates. Should we publish a TCO comparison?
Marco (CTO): Yes, but frame it as an ops/TCO story: show typical monthly bill for representative workloads after batching/caching. Not just list price.
Jules (PM): For sales decks, are there any quick safe claims about latency SLAs?
Aisha (CEO): Avoid hard SLAs for hosted. For Dedicated/private, we can state latency targets and SLA availability. Use p95 targets with context.
Priya (Growth): Messaging ask: what makes Redwood hard to copy? Is it our runtime tech, ops, or product integration?
Marco (CTO): It's the system-level combos: runtime kernels + smart routing + cache + rollout controls. Competitors might have pieces but not the integrated stack plus observability.
Dana (Product): Also our evals & curated model variants saves customers engineering time — that's a practical moat.
Sam (Eng): Roadmap check: prioritize kernel optimizations vs rollout UX next quarter?
Aisha (CEO): Both matter. Prioritize kernel/latency wins to reduce churn, then rollout UX to accelerate enterprise closes.
Jules (PM): Any quick guidance for engineers when asked about open model support?
Marco (CTO): Say we support major open models and provide Redwood-verified variants tuned for latency and cost. That's faster and safer than customers tuning from scratch.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/ops/rollouts shared :link: 
Priya (Growth): I'll draft two short pitch hooks (dev + enterprise) and share in #marketing by end of day.
Dana (Product): I'll follow up with a one-slide cheat sheet for sales.
Aisha (CEO): Perfect. I'll close thread in 24h unless more Qs. Thanks everyone! :tada:
